description: Retele de utilitati - apa si canalizare - serviciu de vizualizare is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.ancpi.ro. INSPIRE visualization service for the dataset Utility networks - water and sewerage in INSPIRE format. Coverage: RO. The portal shows the English title as "Utility networks - water and sewerage - visualization service" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
